_comment: Guardrail budgets enforced by CI. Only the Director may raise these, with a DECISIONS.md entry explaining why.

playerFrameMs._comment: Real players' frame times from telemetry (#373), held by the studio-health watchdog (scripts/playerTelemetry.cjs): a level whose median phone-session p95 frame time over 24 h (3+ sessions) is above touchP95 gets a studio-health issue. 33.4 ms: the VISION bar is 60 fps on a mid-range phone, and a p95 past two vsyncs means visible stutter.

smokeSeconds._comment: Wall time of each CI smoke shard (e2e/shards.mjs), checked by the smoke on CI (#353): 1.5x the slowest CI run on #411 (2026-11-07, the PR depth of #372: four runs, ui and menus one; runs swung up to ~60%), rounded up to 30 s, ui and menus to 120 s; mobile 1.3x.

scene._comment: Per-level ceilings checked by the smoke (#188): drawCalls at the ride screenshot (camera-dependent: +20% over the higher of two runs on 2026-10-31; level4 and level5 hold the VISION bar of 250, #260), scene and track (objects named track*) objects and triangles from sceneStats() (camera-independent: +15%). knownOver: "#<open issue>" turns a failure into a warning until that issue lands.
